headline: M2: historical-context retrieval complete for 100 cases.
detail: The 100-observation suitable benchmark pool is assembled and deterministic historical-context retrieval is complete for every case. The index contains 1,952 retrieved context rows across all 100 observations; 68 cases have time-level timestamp evidence, 5 have date-only evidence, and 27 have unknown timestamp precision. No relationship ground-truth labels have been assigned. M2 now advances to materializing the retrieved historical evidence and human context-sufficiency review before relationship adjudication.
next_gate: Materialize retrieved historical evidence for the 100 suitable observations and complete human context-sufficiency review before relationship adjudication.
public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, historical-context evidence, raw operational records, and case-level decisions are not exposed by this status artifact.
